title: AI Course Lesson
description: Schema for a single lesson in the Generative AI & Machine Learning Course. Corresponds to an entry under COURSE_DATA.levels.<levelKey>.lessons.<lessonId> in course-data.js or practical-examples.js. See docs/CONTENT_MODEL.md for guidance.
comment: P0 scaffold: labChecks/tracks/capstone are optional (PLAN §1A/§1B/§4). JSON wins over inline JS once loader.js lands (P5).

id.description: Snake-case identifier unique across all lessons, e.g. 'ai_introduction', 'rag_vector_databases'.

title.description: Short display title in the navigation and at the top of the lesson.

level.description: The level tier the lesson belongs to.

number.description: Sequential lesson number across the whole course (1..N), no gaps.

estimatedTime.description: Estimated time to complete in minutes. Be honest - see Roadmap T5.5.

difficulty.description: 1 = gentle intro, 5 = research-level. Used only for display, not gating.

prerequisites.description: List of lesson IDs that must be completed before this lesson unlocks. Empty array means no prereqs.

unlocked.description: False = locked behind prereqs (the default). True = always unlocked.

content.description: Lesson body as an HTML string (rendered inside the lesson container). Use <div class="lesson-section"> blocks. May embed template helpers like ${createCodeBlock(...)} or ${renderInteractiveLab()} - these are evaluated in JS at build time, before schema validation.

concepts.description: Concept tags this lesson covers. Used by adaptive-learning reinforcement. At least one concept should be referenced by each quiz question.

labChecks.description: Optional autograded checks (PLAN P1). Max 5 per lesson in v1.

passingScore.description: 0-100. MUST be reachable by the discretized scores of N questions, e.g. 60 for 5 questions (achievable scores: 0/20/40/60/80/100). See Roadmap C13.

questions.description: At least 5 questions per quiz (Roadmap T5.1).

type.description: mcq-code = code-reading MCQ (spot-the-bug), same scoring, different analytics tag (PLAN P1).

isCorrect.description: True for the one correct option.

explanation.description: Shown in quiz review mode; explain WHY the correct answer is correct.

concept.description: A concept tag referenced by the lesson's concepts array.

type.description: Implementation key matched in ai-animations.js drawFrame(). Adding new types requires implementing the draw method or the animation silently falls back.

controls.description: List of control names (mostly informational; the JS source is the source of truth for which controls actually render).

kind.description: pyodide-assert runs in AILab; colab-assert is import-checked in CI; mcq-code is code-reading fallback.

assertCode.description: Python asserts appended after user code. No network.

track.description: Which tracks see this check. Omit = all tracks.

leader.description: Display name is Manager; id stays 'leader' for compat (PLAN D-track).
